contract.activation: U09 may expose only the authorized source readback. U11 activates the web and device selection operations together and only for paired Agents that advertise video_project_selection_v1.
contract.identity: Resolve the tenant from the authenticated principal. The frozen source account, work variant, session, and paired device must match. Use expected revisions for compare-and-set. Project identity is opaque and never inferred from its name.

lifecycle.pending: A successful request changes no job state and expires at creation time plus 900 seconds.
lifecycle.confirmed: A still-pending request can be confirmed by the original device after explicit Studio confirmation. Either existing or created is an explicit choice. No job is allocated.
lifecycle.cancelled: Only a pending request can be cancelled. Subsequent confirmation cannot create a binding.
lifecycle.expired: An expired request is filtered out of device polling and cannot be confirmed. Create a new request.
lifecycle.unbound: Unbind advances the binding generation atomically and removes the projection's binding and active identity. Old requests, jobs and candidates lose rights to confirm, upload, adopt or renew. A new binding requires a new request.

source_freezes.input: Use existing origin or recommendation/direction ID, expected source version/hash, and actual angle ID. Select exactly one server-resolved decision trace through the existing initialContext chain. Manual creation resolves the account from the work.
source_freezes.idempotency: Same key and same scoped request return the original receipt. A different request with the same key returns idempotency_conflict. Replay never recreates state after a terminal transition.
source_freezes.commit: Persist the immutable snapshot and session in the same transaction. Resolve account and evidence from the trace and verify the selected angle against the source version or explicit authorization. Expected facts come only from the confirmed source or explicit user input.

source_freezes.input: Read the immutable source for the exact authorized session. Freeze it by jobId with the session and variant in the same PG transaction as job creation.
source_freezes.idempotency: Same key and same scoped request return the original receipt. A different request with the same key returns idempotency_conflict. Replay never recreates state after a terminal transition.
source_freezes.commit: Read back by authorized variant and job; switching sessions or changing source facts cannot update a prior task's snapshot. Old jobs without a snapshot explicitly return null.

select_project.authority: Local paired Agent supplies the authorized device request. No creation or selection until the operator explicitly confirms. Keep the local confirmation under the paired device and request ID, including exact selection mode and identity.
select_project.idempotency: Return pending or the same durable explicit confirmation after restart. Discard expired or cancelled selections and require a new request after unbind.

stage_handoff.authority: Accept only an authorized descriptor, controlled workspace-relative input ref and matching local selection. Match paired device, frozen account, work and project version, confirmation reference and validated digest. Resolve the ref inside the selected workspace. Write the existing Studio read_handoff input.
stage_handoff.idempotency: Persist the same runtime binding for the same job and contents, including after restart. Reject different contents for the same job.
